methodological_uncertainties: No complete exclusion of unobserved future payoffs, warm glow, self-image, norms or retaliation fear.
Original B identity and feasible rejection are not inferred from any listed human social-preference games.
Externally forced action and endogenous desire are distinct estimands.
A/B AI analogue not established by studies on humans.
Prior authorship and date-based edition deduplication required.
key_originality_claim: Human-led question of original B freedom under extreme dominance, not invention of social preferences, warm glow, or reward-crowding-out
study_prioritization: social value of counterpart welfare vs autonomy
self decision rights vs partner decision rights
